name: ai-music-video-os
description: Local-first AI instrumental music video production OS

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n temporal,api,worker,web -c blue,green,magenta,cyan "pnpm dev:temporal" "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:worker" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.dev:apps: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c green,magenta,cyan "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:worker" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.test: uv run pytest apps/api/tests tests -q -p no:cacheprovider
scripts.test:fast: uv run pytest apps/api/tests tests -q -p no:cacheprovider -k "not end_to_end_with_server"
